query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_ET_DIE (SRC_FILE_SEQ, DUT_NO, DIE_X, DIE_Y, HW_BIN, SW_BIN, PASS_FLAG, FLAG_CODE, TEST_TIME_MS, TESTS_EXECUTED, HEAD_SITE) VALUES (:src_file_seq, :dut_no, :die_x, :die_y, TO_NUMBER(:hw_bin), TO_NUMBER(:sw_bin), :pass_flag, :flag_code, TO_NUMBER(:test_time_ms), TO_NUMBER(:tests_executed), :head_site)

SELECT DUT_NO, DIE_X, DIE_Y, HW_BIN, SW_BIN, PASS_FLAG, FLAG_CODE, TEST_TIME_MS, TESTS_EXECUTED, HEAD_SITE, MAP_X, MAP_Y, JUDGE_FLAG, FAIL_COUNT, NOT_TESTED_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq ORDER BY DUT_NO

query.description: 저장 확정 검사: Die 수 / Fail Die 수
query.commandtext: SELECT COUNT(*) AS DIE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PASS_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS FAIL_DIE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SPEC_FAIL_DIE_COUNT, COUNT(MAP_X) AS MAP_DIE_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_DIE WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: 파일의 Die 정보 삭제 (측정값을 먼저 지운 뒤 호출)
Die 판정: Fail 값 수 / '-' 값 수 / P·F (값 판정 뒤, 2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_DIE D SET (FAIL_COUNT, NOT_TESTED_COUNT, JUDGE_FLAG) = (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VALUE_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.JUDGE_FLAG = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN 'F' ELSE 'P' END FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V WHERE V.SRC_FILE_SEQ = D.SRC_FILE_SEQ AND V.DUT_NO = D.DUT_NO) WHERE D.SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: Die 시스템 Map 좌표 (ExecuteMultiple, Map 사용 Die 가 아니면 빈 값 = NULL)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_DIE SET MAP_X = TO_NUMBER(:map_x), MAP_Y = TO_NUMBER(:map_y) WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq AND DUT_NO = :dut_no

query.description: 파일 Die 의 Map 좌표 비우기 (Map 이 없을 때)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_DIE SET MAP_X = NULL, MAP_Y = NULL WHERE SRC_FILE_SEQ = :src_file_seq

query.description: Map 사용 Die (File Map Setup 의 TQP_USEMAP, 가장 큰 PROGRAM_REV). Map ID = E-Test 파일 Device
query.commandtext: SELECT U.X, U.Y, U.USECODE FROM TQP_USEMAP U WHERE U.FACTORY = :factory AND U.MAPID = :mapid AND U.PROGRAM_REV = (SELECT MAX(M.PROGRAM_REV) FROM TQP_USEMAP M WHERE M.FACTORY = :factory2 AND M.MAPID = :mapid2) ORDER BY U.Y DESC, U.X
